text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuugh... 
My stomach... hurts so bad...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumaeee! Hang in thereee! 
Ugh, "stress-induced gastroenteritis"... 
That sounds so awful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad it wasn't anything too 
serious. 
The doctor said she'd recover after 
resting for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'll go report to the staff! 
Acute-san, I'm leaving her with you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, just relax now... 
I'll bring you a hot water bottle and some 
warm water in a moment.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm... so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What do you have to apologize for? It 
couldn't be helped. 
You've come all this way and worked so 
hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But that goes... for everyone else too...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're always thinking about things twice 
as much as the rest of us, aren't you, 
Tarumae-chan? 
There are surely so many details you 
notice that we don't.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So things like this are bound to happen... 
That's just who you are, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That's no excuse. 
I just... failed to take proper care of 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm going to sleep now. 
Thank you, and sorry for the trouble...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Good night. Rest well and get better 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(What do you mean, 'stress-induced'...?! 
I'm so stupid... stupid, stupid, 
stupid...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I have to get better fast... But what if 
I don't? 
Even if I do, what if I don't practice 
enough...? What should I do, ahh...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ 
A grand explosion of luck today too~~~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Today will be individual 
practice, then. 
We will push back group rehearsals until 
Tarumae-san returns.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Also, regarding the local commercial 
Tarumae-san was scheduled to film today, 
if someone could step in to replace her――

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yes, yes, yes! I'll do it! 
If it lets Tarumae focus on the live show, 
I'll do anything...!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Take 12! Action!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Midsummer Beachside Dirt Fest" will be 
held on the dates shown on screen! 
Admission is completely free! Come on by 
and join the fun~☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Please come by~~♪

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Cut...! That's a wrap.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Whew~~... Finally 
didn't stumble over my words. 
My hand placement finally matched up 
too~~...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for making them cut down my 
lines, too. 
It's quite tough for me to speak fast for 
difficult announcements...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it was very sudden notice. 
Just memorizing the lines must have been 
exhausting. Great work, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan really is the best at this 
sort of thing, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But there's no point in lingering 
on that. 
Let's give it our all so Tarumae can rest 
easy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmmghhhhh!! 
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Never give up, stay hungry!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"May Copa bring you good fortune♪ 
...Copano Rickey☆" ...Aand done. 
Alright, about halfway through now!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it. Man, sorry for making you 
write so many. 
This is definitely going to make the 
raffle giveaway a huge hit. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Tarumae! Are you sure you should be 
walking around already?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm feeling completely fine now. 
I'll be back in action tomorrow. 
By the way, I heard about the commercial 
shoot earlier today.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah~ well, I ended up getting a 
bunch of retakes. 
Maybe I'm just not cut out for it? 
Apparently I come off way too energetic 
when I do it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But it was super fun! It's not every day 
you get a chance like that, after all♪ 
Besides, trying new things brings good 
fortune in Feng Shui too☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... Um, I'm sorry for causing you 
so much troub—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be! At times like this, say 'thank 
you' instead of 'sorry.' 
...Wait, waaah! I was talking and totally 
misspelled a character~!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no... Do we have any spare 
autograph boards...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine! I'll just fill this in like 
thiiis... and voila! 
A Taijitu symbol☆"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, then that makes it a super rare lucky 
autograph board! People love rare ones, 
you know."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Wait, you can just do that...?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe♪ Turned it right back into good 
fortune☆ 
With the power of Feng Shui, mistakes are 
nothing to fear!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"(Rickey's always like this... 
How does she manage to stay that way...?)"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"(Endlessly positive, always smiling no 
matter what, and even though she's a total 
scatterbrain, things somehow always work 
out for her...)"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Must be nice... She has everything I 
don't...)
